Chapter 1319: 5: Lord Divinity

Chapter 1319: Chapter 5: Lord Divinity

But there is no way to prove that the Perfect Time Being does not exist.

Since it cannot be proven either way.

Then the past should not be altered.

If the Perfect Time Being truly exists, and the past, present, and future are all under its watchful eyes, then taking action to change it on your own would be tantamount to defying the Perfect Time Being.

In such a case, no matter how strong a Time Lord, they will surely die.

“Hmm?”

Lin Yuan seemed to sense something.

Looking across various parts of this Fang Yuan World.

At the moment he condensed into a Lord’s position.

The cultivators of this Fang Yuan World, their physical and mental strengths simultaneously plummeted one level.

Their potential also significantly began to decline.

Returning to the levels before the major changes in heaven and earth.

This caused countless cultivators to feel unease and trepidation.

If it weren’t for the current ‘demon’ disaster being mostly suppressed by Lin Yuan.

It would not have been possible to find even a Demon Spirit, let alone a major demon, in various places.

Only then were losses avoided.

“Back then, the Lord rank shattered and merged deeply into the bloodline of life in this world, causing a significant enhancement in bloodline potential.”

“Now that the Lord rank has been reconsolidated by me, it is equivalent to retrieving this power from the depths of all living beings’ bloodlines, so everything naturally returns to its original state.”

Lin Yuan understood this point.

However, now that the demon disaster is mostly suppressed by him, and after stepping into the thirteenth tier, he will thoroughly clean up the demon disaster.

There is really no undue advantage being taken.

In fact, without Lin Yuan, even if the potential of the physical body was greatly enhanced, what would it matter?

The most likely ending is still falling under the endless demon disaster.

…

“This time the awakened physical body, imprinted upon the mind and will, does not need to be comprehended and then made applicable with the other two true selves.”

Lin Yuan continued to feel the Lord’s rank.

The previous eight Divine Skills marks required Lin Yuan to thoroughly comprehend them.

But the Lord rank does not require this.

In some sense, the Lord rank is not a Divine Skill.

It is imprinted on the mind and will; whoever condenses it first owns it.

Thus, at this moment.

Not only does Lin Yuan’s true self in Fang Yuan World get the blessing of the Lord rank.

The true self in the Chaos Void, the first source world, also receives the blessing of the Lord rank.

“That’s also good.”

Lin Yuan nodded slightly.

Now that he is on the cusp of breaking through to the thirteenth tier.

He naturally wants to devote all his energy to the cultivation path.

As for comprehending a certain Divine Skill mark?

He can completely wait to comprehend it after stepping into the thirteenth tier.

Being able to be universally applied to all true selves now without special comprehension is also in line with Lin Yuan’s expectations.

…

Hum hum hum～

Outside the second source world.

A space enclosed by infinite light.

Thirteen towering figures were simultaneously resisting the suppression of the surrounding light, while quickly observing Lin Yuan’s future timeline.

A future timeline that is certain to become a Time Lord is of great value to beings of time, especially since Lin Yuan is not yet a time being.

Peering isn’t too difficult.

Once Lin Yuan becomes a time being, it will be much more challenging for them to peer and observe like this.

Just as the thirteen Eternal Lords were carefully observing and peering.

All timelines related to Lin Yuan suddenly seemed to be affected by something, becoming vague and indistinct.

Even with the utmost effort of the thirteen Eternal Lords, all future timelines began to be gradually obstructed.

“Hmm? What’s happening?”

“Why can’t I see clearly anymore?”

The Eternal Lords’ expressions turned to astonishment; for a true being of time, the timelines of life below the thirteenth tier are as clear as the lines on one’s palm.

Even though Lin Yuan’s direct combat power rivals that of an Eternal Lord, he is ultimately not a time being, logically unable to prevent their observation and scrutiny.

“The Galaxy… is not even an Eternal Lord, and yet its timeline can already block our peering observation?”

“This is too monstrous…”

The thirteen Eternal Lords gradually reacted, and none dared to continue observing forcefully.

They didn’t know the intensity of the blockade, but as entities of the same dimensional space, the Eternal Lords held a lot of goodwill towards Lin Yuan.

“Forget it, if we can’t glimpse, then we can’t glimpse.”

The Master of Infinite sighed.

He had long known this day would come, but he didn’t expect it so soon.

He wasn’t a time life entity, yet possessed the combat power of an Eternal Lord; now he has started to block his own time line, thwarting all prying eyes.

Such a method is simply unheard of, even for someone as knowledgeable as the Master of Infinite, who has had much contact with time life entities outside the source world, yet never heard of it.

…

The first source world.

The six ancestors also discovered that Lin Yuan’s future timeline had begun to blur, gradually becoming blocked.

“How did the Galaxy manage to do this?”

The six ancestors were astounded, not long ago they had just caught a glimpse of Lin Yuan’s real strength from his future timeline, but before they could delve deeper, they found themselves unable to see it anymore.

“I estimate that soon, Galaxy’s strength will have completely surpassed mine.” Da Fu Ancestor thought silently.

Among the six ancestors of this source world, his strength was the greatest, being the first time life at the beginning of the world.

Yet in facing Lin Yuan, the rising star, he felt a sense of despair and suffocation.

“It’s a good thing though.”

“At least without seeing those futures, there is no pressure.”

Da Fu Ancestor sighed in his heart.

…

Chaos Void.

“Hmm?”

“We just started observing, why can’t we continue?”

The seven thirteenth-level time life entities sensed something, exchanging glances.

Although feeling helpless, they understood that if they couldn’t continue to observe, it meant Lin Yuan didn’t want them to.

In such a circumstance, no time life entity dared to forcefully observe.

Are you kidding? With the inevitable future of Lin Yuan becoming a Time Lord, even with ten lives, they wouldn’t dare.

…

The blessing of the lord status.

Lin Yuan immediately felt that his three true bodies’ main bodies felt much ‘lighter.’

This ‘lightness’ had no cause, no origin, but it was undeniably felt.

“Continue on the journey.”

Lin Yuan’s Taiji Primordial Spirit headed swiftly towards the position of the Yin Yang Twin Flowers.

The mysterious dimensional gap was truly boundless, enough to accommodate time life entities as they navigated within.

“This journey, there have been quite a few gains.”

Lin Yuan was in a delightful mood, as the dimensional gap, vast and infinite, also nurtured various dimensional rare treasures.

By observing his future timeline, Lin Yuan mostly gathered various dimensional rare treasures along the way.

It’s known… to open up his internal endless Constant Sand Particle World, Lin Yuan practically invested all his resources.

Currently, he’s in a very ‘poor’ state.

These dimensional rare treasures are like sending charcoal in the snow.

“Is that really such a large piece of eternal gold?” Lin Yuan’s eyes brightened, looking towards a small golden mountain in the distance.

Eternal gold, a thirteenth-level metal, was used by Lord Mo Xu when establishing the ‘Infinite Void’ legacy as the measure of the internal universe power size for cultivators.

But the largest piece of eternal gold within the jade gourd was only a few hundred meters large, while the golden mountain in the distance was tens of thousands of miles?

Eternal gold isn’t considered precious at the thirteenth level, but a mountain of it is quite rare.

“Suppress.”

Lin Yuan’s thoughts moved slightly.

The Power of Yin and Yang surged forth, pressing down on the golden mountain.

“There’s indeed a problem.”

Lin Yuan immediately detected some form of resistance; a powerful life form existed within the golden mountain, but facing Lin Yuan’s Chaotic Taiji Dao, beings below the thirteenth level didn’t stand a chance.

“A special dimensional life form?”

Lin Yuan collected the eternal gold mountain and discovered a dimensional life form nestled inside, a golden insect that consumed eternal gold.

“I’ll research it when I return.”

Lin Yuan casually threw the eternal gold mountain into the Taiji Primordial Spirit’s internal universe.

“The dimensional gap nurtures countless treasures and also countless dangers.”

Lin Yuan sighed, pondering how every dimensional rare treasure he collected on this journey came with dangers, yet because he was strong enough, he could disregard them.

The eternal gold mountain was the same; the golden insect within was no simple creature, even an Invincible Great Saint approaching it would instantly perish.

“Hmm?” Lin Yuan continued his journey, suddenly sensing a ripple, prompting a change in his expression as he looked in another direction, his gaze deep in thought, “Is that the greatest opportunity I might encounter, among the numerous timelines I witnessed?”
